meta.parties: Kandiah v. Village Committee of Atchuvely

rules.statement: The right claimed by the plaintiff Village Committee is not vested in them under section 39 of the Village Communities Ordinance as it does not meet the criteria for immovable property.
rules.supporting_quote: "Now a right to water cattle is an incorporeal right and would therefore not properly fall under the description of immovable property in a context such as this."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 39 of the Village Communities Ordinance
